title: Traditional German Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew filled with earthy flavors, perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
4. Add the onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
6. Add the red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, and thyme to the pot.
7. Stir to combine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
8. Return the beef to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
9. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
11. Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme, if desired.
